packageRules.description: Ported from the removed .github/dependabot.yml ignore: Renovate must not open typescript minor/major upgrade PRs at all - the compiler stays inside its reviewed support window (Dependabot ignored these upgrades outright; automerge:false alone would still open mergeable PRs). Remove or narrow this rule only in the same PR as the migration.

Ported from the removed .github/dependabot.yml ignore: Renovate must not open @types/node major upgrade PRs at all - the Node type declarations stay on their reviewed major support window. Remove or narrow this rule only in the same PR as the migration.
